item.title: Class of 2026 Graduation Information
item.description:
Seniors must complete the Scholarship Post Secondary Google Form by April 21st. Information collected will be used in the commencement program. Graduation is May 21st, 2026 at 6:30 PM at Talawanda High School, 5301 University Park Blvd. Oxford, OH 45056. Graduates must arrive no later than 5:30 PM. Graduation practice is May 21st at 11:00 AM in the THS Gym (arrive by 10:15 AM). Students must provide their transportation. Participation in commencement is optional, but if you don't attend rehearsal, you will NOT be permitted to participate in the ceremony. Cap and gown from Jostens are required (rental items must be returned right after the ceremony). Diplomas can be picked up May 27th between 8 AM-2 PM if not attending. Photos will be available at www.events.lifetouch.com and ceremony will be live-streamed on "Brave TV Channel 85" on YouTube.

item.title: Lions Club Eyeglass Collection Drive
item.description:
The Oxford Lions Club is collecting used eyeglasses, sunglasses, and cases to donate to children in need worldwide. The donated glasses are modified to meet individual children's vision needs, with the Lions Club sending over 900 pairs annually. Donations should be sent to Betsy Beaton at Marshall Elementary School or Shaunna Tafelski at the Board Office by mid-May. Pick-up or drop-off available at Marshall Elementary or the Board Office.

item.title: End-of-Year Vaccine Clinic for Students
item.description:
Free vaccine clinic for all school-aged children on April 3, 2026 at Butler County Educational Service Center (400 N Erie Blvd, Hamilton, OH 45011). Two time slots available: 9am-11am and 1pm-3pm. All required school vaccines provided by Butler County General Health District and Kroger Pharmacy.

If you have Medicaid or government insurance: Call 513-887-5253 or text 513-857-2115 to schedule.

If you have private insurance: Use QR code or benefit code BCGHVAC26 to register through Kroger Health. Select vaccines needed and pick April 3rd for available time slots.

Walk-ins accepted but limited. Self-pay option available (cash only, small administration fee).

item.title: Costa Rica Educational Trip 2027
item.description:
EF Educational Tours is offering Talawanda students an educational trip to Costa Rica in 2027, led by Kari Croucher. Activities include ziplining through rainforests, exploring active volcanoes, swimming in natural thermal hot springs, and snorkeling alongside sea turtles and manta rays. Students can enroll at www.eftours.com/3008612UY — spots are limited.

item.title: Teen Mental Health Research Study Opportunity
item.description:
Miami University is conducting a Teenager Emotion Disclosure Study for students in grades 9-12. The study examines how teens talk to caregivers about mental health through a confidential 1-hour online survey. Participants receive $15 for their time. Parent/guardian consent is required. To register or ask questions, contact lead researcher Noelle Marousis at framlab@miamioh.edu. Study approved by Miami University's IRB (#02456r).
